name: Falcon Dash
description: Operator console for OpenClaw: shared Work tracking for people and agents, a KeePassXC credential vault that resolves SecretRefs, service integrations, and authorized document workspaces.

dataDir.description: Directory for Falcon Dash's own databases — Work, integrations, vault policy and audit history. Defaults to a falcon-dash directory inside the gateway state directory. Your KeePassXC database is not stored here; see vaultDatabase.

work.description: Enable the Work page. Default true.

integrations.description: Enable the Integrations page. Default true.

vault.description: Enable the Vault page. Default true.

documents.description: Enable the Documents page. Default true.

modules.description: Turn individual pages off. Every page is enabled unless you set it to false. Disabling a page also stops its tools and gateway methods being registered.

vaultOwners.description: Profile IDs recorded in the vault policy for the audit trail. This is not an access allowlist: reaching an authenticated Gateway connection is the credential, so any operator who can sign in to the Control UI can reveal any entry. Restrict Gateway sign-in, not this list.

vaultExecutors.description: Agent identifiers permitted to perform non-human vault operations, such as an agent creating or rotating a credential it owns. Agents can never reveal a value regardless of this setting. Checked on every worker call as a defence against a stale service instance.

id.description: Short identifier shown in the Documents page and used in paths.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory. Relative paths are rejected.

actors.description: Actor identifiers allowed to reach this root. Required and must be non-empty — a root with no actors is rejected rather than being open to everyone.

writable.description: Allow writes. Omitted or false means read-only; only an explicit true permits create, edit, rename and delete.

documentRoots.description: Directories the Documents page may reach. Anything not listed here is unreachable, and there is no default root.

oauthRedirectUris.description: Exact redirect URIs accepted when completing a provider OAuth flow. Leave empty to keep OAuth disabled. Maximum 10.

vaultDatabase.description: Absolute path to the KeePassXC database the Vault manages. Defaults to passwords.kdbx in the gateway state directory. An existing database at this path is adopted as-is and its entries are never rewritten.

vaultKeyFile.description: Absolute path to the key file that opens vaultDatabase. Defaults to vault.key in the gateway state directory. Access is key-file only; there is no master-password prompt.
